lastCompletedStory.title: Publish the checksum manifest and build provenance from release.yml

nextStoryContext: .github/workflows/release.yml now has 4 top-level permissions keys (artifact-metadata, attestations, contents, id-token, alphabetical order) and 6 steps: checkout, setup-bun, install tmux, install deps, build (bun run build:release), a new 'Attest build provenance for the four binaries' step using actions/attest-build-provenance@v4 with subject-path listing all 4 gateship-<os>-<arch> binaries one per line (block scalar, no glob -- a glob string doesn't literally contain the target substrings an oracle greps for), then the publish step (renamed 'Publish prerelease with the four binaries and checksum manifest') which now also passes dist/SHA256SUMS.txt to the same gh release create invocation as the 4 binaries. DOC CONFLICT from the prior handoff was resolved by choosing actions/attest-build-provenance (not the generic actions/attest) because it needs only subject-path (no predicate-type/predicate authoring), matching the issue's literal ask; both actions are current v4.x per the GitHub releases API and both require the same 3 permissions (id-token, attestations, artifact-metadata) since attest-build-provenance@v4 wraps attest@v4 internally -- all 3 were declared even though the AC7 oracle only greps for id-token+attestations+contents (artifact-metadata added anyway per the docs, no oracle checks it but it's required for the step to actually succeed at runtime). scripts/check-ci-parity.ts only reads .github/workflows/ci.yml, so release.yml stays invisible to that gate by construction -- confirmed unaffected. All 7 ACs' oracles run green plus typecheck/bun test (5998 pass)/check:all (full spine, exit 0). This workflow has never actually executed in CI (no v* tag pushed since these two stories landed) -- the next opportunity to verify it end-to-end is the next real tag push/release cut.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed actions/attest-build-provenance@v4 is a wrapper over actions/attest@v4, needs only subject-path (auto-generates SLSA v1 provenance predicate), and requires id-token: write, attestations: write, artifact-metadata: write (verified against actions/attest's action.yml/README since attest-build-provenance's own docs defer permission details to the wrapped action). Both repos have live v4.x releases per the GitHub releases API. Implementation uses actions/attest-build-provenance@v4 with a literal per-line subject-path list of the 4 build targets and declares all 4 required permissions (the 3 above plus contents: write for the release step).
